decisions.reason: The source also sets today's deadline for the work report, but that impact is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
The generic work-report request is resolved by the separate periodic reporting Requirement and does not necessarily set a deadline for the complete on-page SEO report.
Requesting the work report and Meta tags list today does not change the image ALT optimization requirement.
The source does not mention or change the Back to School landing-page edits.
The source requests reporting deliverables and does not modify webpage content or its replacement text.
The source does not mention the sitemap or alter its correction and submission outcome.
The work-report and Meta-tag deadline does not change the backlink quantity or link-composition requirements.
The source does not refer to backlink indexing, re-indexing, or the index-status report.
The requested reporting deadline does not change blog production, article count, or publication conditions.
The source does not mention or modify image requirements for blog articles.
The source does not mention or modify internal-link requirements for blog articles.
The Meta tags list is distinct from the campaign keyword list, and the source does not change keyword selection.
